name: Protect Democracy
summary: A cross-partisan US organisation, founded in 2016 by former government lawyers, that works to keep the United States from declining into a more authoritarian form of government. Protect Democracy Project, its 501(c)(3), litigates (election subversion, defamation suits for election workers, executive overreach), builds tools such as VoteShield, which monitors voter rolls, convenes election officials and law enforcement, helps states pass laws protecting election officials, and researches electoral-system reform such as proportional representation. Its 2024 programme cost $28.3 million.
